page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Left margin holds short notes: three lines at the top beside the first paragraph, and two lines lower down beside the start of the second paragraph. Running head at top; page number 74 at top left.

main_text.p: in illa ora- [?]σαρκοφα- γία.lim fuit vt à nullis minùs agnitus, & nullis magis exosus, fuerit vnicus ille nofter Seruatore quàm Sacerdotum principibus: persuasit miseris Christi ouiculis, non illam modò falsissimam præsentiam, quæ tandem ad Vbiquitatem vsque progressa fuit, sed illud etiam ipsum quod ne superstitiosissimis quidem Ægyptiis allia & cepe adoratibus perfuasum fuisse Cicero annotauit: nempe id ipsum esse Deum, quo vescerentur. Annon enim hæc ipsa est eorum qui Transubstantiatione tuentur fides ? Alter autem ille num minus crassus est error, qui nunc horrendas istas turbas excitat, Germanicas præsertim Ecclesias & Academias floretissimas deuastás?Hoc enim factū est vt qui illum ipsum, magnū alioqui virum, vsque in hæc deuia à spiritu contentionis abreptum sunt secuti, à quo cognominari gaudent, credi velint illud ipsum Christi corpus pro nobis traditum, & illum ipsum sanguinem pro nobis effusum, ore ipso, inuisibiliter quidem, sed tam verè tamen, & tam proprie actualiter ac reipsa, quàm panem, illum & vinum illud, non tantùm edi & bibi, verùm etiã manducantium quoruuis DENTIBVS SENSVALITER ATTERI ? optante etiam illo vt tam verè Christiani fuerint omnes Romani Pontifices quàm fuit impurissimus, ille Nicolaus, qui hanc palinodiam, Berengario misero præscripsit.
Frustra me- [?]taitur perso- na ChristiHic verò mihi fas fit, licet feruorũ Dei ἐλά- χίσῳ[?], vos omnes huius tā portentosi dogmatis, tan-

page.notes: The text runs on at the page foot ("tan-"), so the paragraph continues on the next page. "tuen tur" is split at the line end with no printed hyphen; written whole as "tuentur". The Greek word "ἐλά-/χίσῳ" at the line end is hard to read: the second part is uncertain. The left margin notes are small and partly hard to read: the Greek in the first note and the word "taitur" in the second are uncertain. "fides ?" and "deuastás?Hoc" keep the spacing as printed. Possible printing errors left as printed: "lim" at the start of the first line, and "floretissimas".
